preconditions.description: The dimensions of the garden must be within the specified bounds.
The number of important squares must be at least 1 and at most the minimum of n*m and 7.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= aij <= 1000 for row in garden for aij in row)
preconditions.description: The number of flowers in each square must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: len(important_squares) == k and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in important_squares)
preconditions.description: The coordinates of the important squares must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of dead plants followed by the garden plan.

postconditions.expression: all(garden_plan[i][j] == 'X' for i, j in important_squares)
postconditions.description: All important squares must be covered with concrete in the garden plan.

postconditions.expression: all(any(garden_plan[i][j] == 'X' for j in range(m)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: There must be a path of concrete-covered squares connecting all important squares.
